Capitol Hill homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Capitol Hill, September 2026. Detached houses: 40 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 18 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 11 sold over 4 months against an average of 40.5 listed, about 14.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 4 sold. Condos and townhomes: 6 sold over 4 months against an average of 17.8 listed, about 11.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 3 sold.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Capitol Hill address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. Capitol Hill Elementary (K–7) on Holdom Ave is the in-area SD41 school and Burnaby North Secondary (8–12), 751 Hammarskjold Drive, is the North Burnaby secondary school; catchments are address-based and must be checked in the SD41 locator.

faq.q: How do I get downtown or to SFU without a car?
faq.a: The R5 Hastings St RapidBus runs below the hill on Hastings Street, connecting Burrard Station (downtown Vancouver) and the SFU Burnaby Mountain campus, running at least every 10 minutes at peak times; since September 7, 2026 the R2 also runs along Hastings and down Willingdon Avenue to Metrotown Station.

faq.q: What is at the top of Capitol Hill?
faq.a: Capitol Hill Reservoir Park, 229 N Hythe Ave — a small City park listed as a scenic viewpoint park, above the Confederation Park civic cluster of pool, community centre and McGill library branch at Willingdon and Albert.

faq.q: What did homes sell for recently on Capitol Hill?
faq.a: SnapStats does not publish a sub-area median for Capitol Hill. At the Burnaby community level, the September 2026 median sale price was $1,825,000 for detached and $686,000 for condos & townhomes; within Capitol Hill itself, 3 detached homes and 3 attached homes sold that month (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).
